scope: Post-iteration-2 headline fix and direct static-file verification
root_cause: GSAP default lag smoothing made the animation clock advance much slower than wall time under software-rendered low frame rates. The title therefore remained partially masked after long waits.
fix: Disabled GSAP ticker lag smoothing, explicitly cleared title transforms on completion and when reduced motion is enabled.
